name: Parameter count
description: Flags author-defined functions whose parameter list is longer than a configurable maximum.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, an author-defined `Function` whose parameter list is longer than `parameter_count_max` (default 5 on the built-in/`strict` preset, 7 on `standard`, and 10 on `careful`). Optional / defaulted parameters count toward the total. Engine `Event` signatures are never flagged, because their arity is fixed by the runtime.
